originalTitle: Breaking up (with Elon Musk) is hard to do

content: In a throwback to MySpace-style internet drama, Shivon Zilis announced that she and the father of her four children, Elon Musk, had broken up on X. To do so, she quote-tweeted a post from “Big Tech Alert,” an account that, among other things, monitors what accounts are following and unfollowing each other. That post noted Musk was no longer following her on X. It was also sponsored by Kalshi, because everything in this relationship is totally fucking cursed, dude. In her statement, Zilis wrote, “It’s hard to go from in love to let go in a week with no warning, but that’s just how it is sometimes.”  Zilis, in addition to her romantic, uh, entanglement with Musk, also served as… well, she denied under oath that she was his chief of staff but says she worked across Musk’s “entire AI portfolio: Tesla, Neuralink, and OpenAI” during a trial earlier this year, in which Musk sued Sam Altman — long story, there’s some specious legal reasoning but mostly it just looks like punishment for being successful without Musk — over Musk’s donations to OpenAI. During the trial, she claimed to work 80-to-100-hour weeks for Musk, “to go find bottlenecks and solve them.” Musk apparently had a different view of her role, testifying that she was his chief of staff, and “uh, you know,” prompting loud laughter from the courtroom’s gallery. Musk has a history of public flameouts with the women who bear his children. Besides his first wife, Justine Musk, who wrote “I Was a Starter Wife” before going absolutely silent on the subject of her ex, another mother of his children, Ashley St. Clair, has said that she rejected a $40 million NDA from Musk. (She is presently suing him over his chatbot, Grok, making deepfake nudes of her.) Another ex, Grimes, referred to pregnancy as “sacrificing your body and your freedom,” and later sued him to establish a parental relationship. Grimes also posted and deleted a tweet saying “Tell Shivon to unblock me and tell Elon to let me see my son or plz respond to my lawyer” to Musk’s biographer Walter Isaacson in 2023. Musk’s fixer, Jared Birchall, orchestrates privacy deals for Musk with the baby mamas. Musk has 14 known children. Zilis was a member of OpenAI’s board when she gave birth to twins, though she kept the parentage of the children secret. She only informed her coworkers about having kids with one of their competitors in 2022, after Business Insider reported on court documents listing Musk as the children’s father. Musk lived with her at the time of the testimony. During her testimony in the case, Zilis appeared to worship Musk, and her breakup post strikes roughly the same tone. “I feel happy that I got to show Elon how it feels to be deeply understood, nurtured, and peacefully loved with stability and gentleness,” she wrote. “Given the tumultuous nature of his early life, his often tortured soul, and how hard he fights for humanity I wanted him to feel the deepest and most stable form of love this world can provide.” The post is so groveling that had I not witnessed her in court, I would have assumed this was some kind of passive-aggressive revenge strategy. Personally, if one of my exes publicly wrote that I was a poor fragile wreck trying to save the world who desperately needed a haven of safety, I would simply die of embarrassment, but God really does make all kinds.  “I’ve loved him more than life itself and he’s taught me 100 lifetimes of knowledge and made my cup overflow with life meaning, so there is a lot of loss, but luckily we created four beautiful little loves of my life,” Zilis wrote.  Last week, Zilis posted about a memoir written by Maye Musk, Elon’s mother: “During tough moments I think about the resilience she’s shown and realize she’s encountered 100x the difficultly I’ve faced and she made it through with grace! It gives me resolve.” I guess we know now what some of the “tough moments” were. “I would highly recommend this book to anyone who wants a beacon of resilience to draw inspiration from,” she added.

chineseContent: 在 MySpace 风格的网剧中，希文·齐利斯 (Shivon Zilis) 宣布她和四个孩子的父亲埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在 X 上分手。 为此，她引用了“Big Tech Alert”的一条推文，该账户除其他外，还监控哪些账户互相关注和取消关注。那篇帖子指出马斯克不再在 X 上关注她。它也是由 Kalshi 赞助的，因为这段关系中的一切都他妈的被诅咒了，伙计。齐利斯在声明中写道：“在没有任何警告的情况下，一周内从相爱到放手是很难的，但有时就是这样。”  Zilis 除了与马斯克的浪漫纠葛之外，还担任过......好吧，她在宣誓后否认自己是马斯克的幕僚长，但表示，在今年早些时候的一次审判中，她在马斯克的“整个人工智能产品组合：特斯拉、Neuralink 和 OpenAI”中工作过。在这场审判中，马斯克起诉了山姆·奥尔特曼——说来话长，有一些似是而非的法律推理，但大多数情况下，这看起来像是对马斯克在没有马斯克的情况下取得成功的惩罚——因为马斯克向 OpenAI 捐款。在审判期间，她声称每周为马斯克工作 80 到 100 小时，“去寻找瓶颈并解决它们。”马斯克显然对她的角色有不同的看法，他作证说她是他的幕僚长，并且“呃，你知道”，引起法庭旁听席上的大笑。马斯克有公开与为他生孩子的女性断绝关系的历史。除了他的第一任妻子贾斯汀·马斯克（Justine Musk）在对她的前任话题保持绝对沉默之前写过《我是一个初级妻子》之外，他孩子的另一位母亲阿什利·圣克莱尔（Ashley St. Clair）也表示，她拒绝了马斯克提供的 4000 万美元的保密协议。 （她目前正在起诉他的聊天机器人 Grok，该机器人为她制作了深度伪造的裸体照片。） 另一位前男友格莱姆斯 (Grimes) 将怀孕称为“牺牲你的身体”
